# mysurflife

> AI surf forecasting for California. Real-time NOAA buoy observations, 16-day
> wind and wave model forecasts, live storm tracking, and Sione — an AI surf
> forecaster that synthesizes all of it and personalizes to how each surfer
> actually surfs.

mysurflife combines live ocean data with numerical weather models and an AI
layer on top:

- **Live buoys**: 18+ NOAA NDBC stations along the California coast — wave
  height, period, direction, and wind, updated in near real time.
- **Model forecasts**: NOAA GFS wind (16 days) and WaveWatch III / GFSWave wave
  models rendered as interactive map overlays with a scrubbing timeline.
- **Storm tracking**: named tropical systems and extratropical lows parsed from
  NHC/NWS High Seas bulletins, with forecast tracks and per-region swell
  arrival estimates for California surf spots.
- **Sione (AI forecaster)**: a conversational assistant that reads the buoys,
  models, and storm data, answers questions like "when should I paddle out this
  week?", and learns each surfer's preferences from their logged sessions.
- **Session journal**: surfers log sessions; the forecast personalizes over
  time — board choice suggestions, spot ranking, and alert tuning.

The app is free during beta. Full functionality (map, forecasts, Sione)
requires a signed-in account; the public homepage explains the product.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://mysurflife.com/): product overview, how it works, sign-in.

## Data sources

Forecast and observation data come from NOAA (NDBC buoys, GFS, GFSWave/WW3,
NHC/NWS High Seas Forecast bulletins), CDIP, NOS CO-OPS stations, and
Open-Meteo. mysurflife adds interpolation, per-spot calibration, swell-arrival
physics, and AI synthesis on top.
